image_description: A black and white photograph depicting a traditional May Day celebration. A tall, central wooden pole (maypole) is decorated with a floral wreath at the top. Numerous long ribbons extend from the top to the ground, where they are held by a circle of children dressed in light-colored dresses or tunics. The children appear to be dancing or weaving around the pole. In the background, there are spectators, trees, and what appears to be a tent or stall.
